n4ff66b6636.headline: Citizen movement asks creditors not to block Mozambique's debt cut
n4ff66b6636.summary: A citizen movement called on creditors to support Mozambique's debt restructuring, while the IMF insists aid depends on debt sustainability.
n4ff66b6636.why: Mozambique’s debt situation affects its economic stability and access to international financing, influencing regional credit markets.
